parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.2.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set routing-options autonomous-system 70.explanation: 配置设备的自治系统号。

parameters.name: autonomous-system
parameters.explanation: 设备的自治系统号，用于BGP等路由协议。

set protocols bgp group BGP_GROUP type e.command: set protocols bgp group BGP_GROUP type external

set protocols bgp group BGP_GROUP neighb.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] peer-as [parameter3]
set protocols bgp group BGP_GROUP neighb.command: set protocols bgp group BGP_GROUP neighbor 10.2.1.2 peer-as 100
set protocols bgp group BGP_GROUP neighb.explanation: 配置BGP邻居及其自治系统号。

set protocols bgp group BGP_GROUP family.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group BGP_GROUP family.command: set protocols bgp group BGP_GROUP family inet unicast

set protocols bgp group BGP_GROUP neighb.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group BGP_GROUP neighb.command: set protocols bgp group BGP_GROUP neighbor 10.2.1.2 family inet unicast

set protocols bgp group BGP_GROUP export.command: set protocols bgp group BGP_GROUP export ADVERTISE_NETWORK
set protocols bgp group BGP_GROUP export.explanation: 配置BGP组使用指定的策略进行路由导出。

parameters.name: policy
parameters.explanation: 用于路由导出的策略名称。

set policy-options policy-statement ADVE.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] from route-filter [parameter3] exact
set policy-options policy-statement ADVE.command: set policy-options policy-statement ADVERTISE_NETWORK term 1 from route-filter 10.2.1.0/24 exact
set policy-options policy-statement ADVE.explanation: 配置策略语句的匹配条件，精确匹配指定的路由。

set policy-options policy-statement ADVE.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] then accept
set policy-options policy-statement ADVE.command: set policy-options policy-statement ADVERTISE_NETWORK term 1 then accept
set policy-options policy-statement ADVE.explanation: 配置策略语句的动作，接受匹配的路由。

set policy-options policy-statement ADVE.command: set policy-options policy-statement ADVERTISE_NETWORK then reject
set policy-options policy-statement ADVE.explanation: 配置策略语句的默认动作，拒绝所有未匹配的路由。
